title: High earners
statementMd:
Find employees whose salary is **greater than 140,000**.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`, `salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 140000;
```

A simple numeric comparison in the `WHERE` clause.

expected.query: SELECT first_name, last_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 140000;
